source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Check the whole thing for any logical weaknesses in the methodology.
3. Check the documentation for major flaws: missing information, hidden liabilities, etc.
4. Identify, if possible, any personal interest/relationship, hidden or not, between the inspector and the inspected company.
5. If the inspector(s) happen to be an ex-employee of the audited company, check whether the former relationship could be the source of the favourable audit report.
6. Double check the inspection detail to make sure it belongs to the correct company.
7. Find out the specifications and standards required by the signed contract between the client and the auditor
8. Check whether the company complied with the 7th step. Else, they have a legal claim against it.
9. Check if the company performs a self-audit procedure in the process.
10. When you encounter an audit with a very detailed report, make sure the contract included
